title: Join slices compare with coherent cocone categories, including fixed apex fibers
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent cocones, functor equivalences and Kan mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For small simplicial sets $X,Y$ define $(X\star Y)_n=X_n\amalg Y_n\amalg\coprod_{a+b+1=n}X_a\times Y_b$, with operators restricting the ordered $X$-block followed by the $Y$-block. Let $a:L\to\mathcal E$ be any small simplicial diagram in a quasicategory. Define the join slice $J_a$ to have $n$-simplices the maps $L\star\Delta^n\to\mathcal E$ restricting to $a$ on $L$, with operators induced by $\operatorname{id}_L\star\Delta(\alpha)$, and projection $J_a\to\mathcal E$ given by restriction to $\Delta^n$. Let $P_a=\{a\}\times_{\operatorname{Fun}(L,\mathcal E),\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\operatorname{Fun}(L,\mathcal E))\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,\operatorname{Fun}(L,\mathcal E)}\mathcal E$ be the coherent cocone category, with its apex projection. Define the fat join $L\diamond X=L\amalg_{L\times\{0\}\times X}(L\times\Delta^1\times X)\amalg_{L\times\{1\}\times X}X$. Restricting the initial and final blocks gives a natural map $L\diamond X\to L\star X$, identical on $L$ and $X$. Precomposition for $X=\Delta^n$ defines a comparison $J_a\to P_a$. This comparison is a functor equivalence of quasicategories over $\mathcal E$. For every vertex $T$ of $\mathcal E$, both strict fibers over $T$ are Kan complexes and the comparison induces an equivalence $J_a\times_{\mathcal E}\{T\}\to P_a\times_{\mathcal E}\{T\}$. The latter target is the space $\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(L,\mathcal E)}(a,\Delta_LT)$ of coherent cocones, up to its natural mapping-space equivalence. These comparisons are natural in $a,L,\mathcal E$, including restriction of the indexing shape, and in the apex, with postcomposition interpreted through coherent composition. A vertex of $J_a$ is initial if and only if its associated coherent cocone is colimiting. The assertions include $L=\varnothing$.
